name: stalwart-mail
description: Mail and contacts on your own Stalwart server, straight from Claude: search, read (attachments and scans too), reply, send, drafts.
long_description:
Talks to a Stalwart mail server over JMAP with the mailbox's own credentials — nothing to install on the server.

It can search and read messages, open attachments (PDF, images, text; scans through Mistral OCR), reply in a thread, send new e-mails with attachments from disk, create drafts for review in webmail, look up addresses in your own and shared address books and in the mail history, and add contacts.

Sending is immediate, so Claude is told to send only on your explicit instruction and to create a draft otherwise. Shared mailboxes and groups the account can access are available through the `account` parameter.

tools.name: mail_list_mailboxes
tools.description: Accounts, folders with message counts and allowed senders

tools.name: mail_search_emails
tools.description: Search messages (full text, from/to, subject, folder, date, unread) and list a thread

tools.name: mail_get_email
tools.description: A whole message by id with its text and the list of attachments

tools.name: mail_get_attachment
tools.description: Open an attachment: text of PDFs and text files, OCR of scans and photographed documents, images, saved to disk

tools.name: mail_send_email
tools.description: Send a new e-mail or a reply in a thread, with attachments from disk

tools.name: mail_create_draft
tools.description: Save a message as a draft for review in webmail

tools.name: mail_search_contacts
tools.description: Find addresses in the address books (own and shared) and in the mail history

tools.name: mail_add_contact
tools.description: Create a contact in an address book (shared ones too)

server_url.title: Server address
server_url.description: Public address of your Stalwart server, e.g. https://mail.example.com (the one that serves /.well-known/jmap).

email.title: Mailbox e-mail
email.description: The full address you sign in with, e.g. jane@example.com.

password.title: Mailbox password
password.description: The mailbox password (or an app password). Stored in the operating system's keychain.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of tool descriptions and output: auto (follow the system), en, cs, de, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt, sk.

mistral_api_key.title: Mistral API key (OCR of scans)
mistral_api_key.description: Optional. With a key, scanned attachments and photos of documents are read through Mistral OCR; without it a scan comes back as an image of page 1 only.
